# Article Writing

Curated by Skill Harbor: a long-form writing skill that makes an agent write like an actual person with a point of view, not an LLM smoothing itself into paste. It covers articles, guides, blog posts, tutorials, and newsletter issues, with a fixed writing process (clarify audience and purpose, hard outline with one job per section, lead with proof or example, cut anything templated) and structure guidance per format (technical guides open with what the reader gets, essays start with tension, newsletters keep the first screen doing real work). The signature discipline is its banned-patterns list: "in today's rapidly evolving landscape", "game-changer", "cutting-edge", fake vulnerability arcs, and engagement-bait closing questions get deleted and rewritten, and a quality gate checks that factual claims are backed by provided sources and the voice matches the supplied examples. It pairs with brand-voice (also in this batch): run that skill first and reuse its VOICE PROFILE instead of re-deriving style here. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: it never invents facts, credibility, or customer evidence, so you must supply the raw material (notes, transcripts, research); output quality depends on the voice examples you give it. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
